Description:
[center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2023/06/12/QwkW2.png[/img]﻿

There will be future updates with more tables added, but for now these are the ones I have.﻿

This mod only contains texture of tables, it replaces the Oak Table, China Cabinet and the Coffe Table.
You will need Alternative Textures for this mod to work ^^.
These are decorative so the objects dont work on the tables, they're just there to be cute :D!

There is currently 20 different designs, 8 for the Oak Table, 8 for the China Cabinet and 4 for the Coffee Table. 
Use the paint bucket to change textures for the furniture that is purchasable from Robin. [/center]
